items.title: Chern classes of a finite locally free sheaf with a trivial line subbundle as a quotient
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Chern classes of a finite locally free sheaf which is an extension of a sheaf of one lower rank by the structure sheaf: the top Chern class vanishes and all the lower ones agree with those of the quotient (statement lines 7862-7878, tag 02UG). The proof is a real comparison through projective bundles: it reduces to an integral base, embeds the projective bundle of the quotient into the projective bundle of the extension, realises the smaller one as an effective Cartier divisor cut out by the constant section so that its normal bundle is trivial, and then pushes the characterising relation of the quotient forward to obtain the relation of the extension, whose uniqueness forces the claimed identifications. The pushforward of the relation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
